name: linear
description: Work with Linear issues, teams, and projects over its GraphQL API using a personal API key (via secretHeaders). Load for issue searches, reads, and creating issues.

content.inline:
## Linear
Linear is GraphQL-only. Calls go through `v/ops/http/post` against `https://api.linear.app/graphql` with `secretHeaders: {"Authorization": "s/LINEAR_API_KEY"}` (a personal API key from Linear -> Settings -> Security & access -> API -> Personal keys; sent as-is, with no "Bearer " prefix). Body is `{query, variables?}`. Only the secret reference goes in the request.

Common operations (POST body `{query, variables}`):
- Whoami: `query { viewer { id name email } }`
- My issues: `query { viewer { assignedIssues(first: 50) { nodes { identifier title state { name } url } } } }`
- Search: `query($q: String!) { issueSearch(query: $q, first: 50) { nodes { identifier title state { name } } } }`
- One issue: `query($id: String!) { issue(id: $id) { identifier title description state { name } assignee { name } } }`
- Teams: `query { teams { nodes { id key name } } }`
- Create: `mutation($t: String!, $team: String!) { issueCreate(input: {title: $t, teamId: $team}) { success issue { identifier url } } }`

Rules:
- Check `status`, but GraphQL returns 200 even on logical errors - also inspect `body.errors`. An `errors` array means the query or permissions failed. 401 = bad API key.
- `teamId` is required to create an issue; fetch it from `teams` first. `issue(id:)` accepts the `ABC-123` identifier or the UUID.
- Request only the fields the task needs; keep selections small.
